# OnyxChat

OnyxChat is a production, end-to-end encrypted messaging platform. All cryptography (ECDH P-256 key exchange, AES-256-GCM message encryption) happens client-side in the browser; the server only ever stores and relays ciphertext and public keys, never plaintext message content.

- Web app: https://onyxchat.dev
- Source code: https://github.com/colecschmidt/onyxchat
